name: Info Edge (India) Ltd
_note: Fact base for the Info Edge initiation (as of 30-Sep-2026, Q1FY27 basis). Rs crore unless stated. Standalone = Info Edge (India) Ltd alone (Naukri and other recruitment brands, 99acres, Jeevansathi, Shiksha); consolidated adds subsidiaries (Zwayam, DoSelect/Axilly, Aisle, Sunrise Mentors/Coding Ninjas, 4B Networks), the controlled AIF trusts (Info Edge Ventures funds) and joint ventures.

q1deck.what: Outcome of board meeting: Q1FY27 standalone and consolidated results, press release, earnings presentation

ar26.what: Annual report FY26 (standalone and consolidated statements, investment notes, shareholding at Mar-2026)

profile.what: India's largest online classifieds group. Naukri.com (jobs, with NaukriGulf, Job Hai, Naukri 360/FastForward, AmbitionBox, Hirist, Zwayam), 99acres.com (real estate), Jeevansathi.com (matrimony, plus Aisle) and Shiksha.com (education). It is also a long-term investor in start-ups: 12.4% of Eternal (Zomato, Blinkit), 12.1% of PB Fintech (Policybazaar) and ~135 unlisted companies through its balance sheet and AIFs.
profile.founded: Incorporated 1995 (CIN L74899DL1995PLC068021); listed Nov-2006 (Screener price history from 24-Nov-2006)

shares.note: Paid-up capital Rs1,296.84 Mn at Rs2 face value = 64.84 cr shares at Jun-2026 (five-for-one split in FY26). Promoter shares 24,31,26,675 = 37.50% at Mar-2026 also implies 64.83 cr.

standalone._note: Rs crore. Segment results are profit before tax of each segment (after its depreciation and finance costs), before unallocated corporate expenses and other income. Op PBT = segment results less unallocated expenses. EBITDA = PBT before exceptional items - other income + finance costs + D&A.
standalone.src: ar23 (FY22-23 segment note, P&L), ar24 (FY24), ar26 (FY25-26, five-year EPS chart, cash), q1deck data sheet (billings, deferred revenue FY24-26); FY25 cash from JM Financial (23-May-2026) table

notes: Exceptional loss Rs72.1 cr (standalone): provision for diminution in a non-current investment, marked down after an additional stake was bought at a lower value.

Recruitment: billings +17.5%, revenue +13.0%, operating PBT +25.4% at a 58.3% margin. Sector billings: IT/BPM +15%, GCCs +31%, consultants +1%, others +12%. Candidate (B2C) billings +35% at a 63% PBT margin.
99acres: billings +16.5%, revenue +17.3%, loss Rs2.1 cr (Rs18.7 cr a year ago); web time-share 49%, app 55%.
Jeevansathi billings +14% (profitable); Aisle +44%; Shiksha billings -23% and revenue -12% on AI-driven search changes.
After the quarter: bought the remaining 45.36% of Sunrise Mentors (Coding Ninjas) for Rs40 cr; Shopkirana stake swapped into Trustroot Internet shares (Jul-2026).
q1fy27.src: q1deck (results, press release, slides 5-27, data sheet); q1call

guidance.text: Investment phase largely behind; expects 99acres to become cash-generative during FY27; long-term aim of 25-30% margins and doubling billings in about three years (Q4FY26 call, per JM Financial 23-May-2026).
Will keep investing aggressively in AI; AI-Rex sold to 400+ clients in Q1 and live at 4,000+ enterprises; Talent Pulse 600+ paid customers; AI-led internal efficiencies of 15-20% in some functions.
Hiring largely replacement-led with some improvement; premium hiring growing 25-30%; enterprise renewals better; no numeric guidance given.
AI-led search headwinds to persist near term; pivot to domestic counselling and AI voicebots.

eternal.note: Group holds 1,19,95,64,695 shares (consolidated note, Mar-2023 to Mar-2026, unchanged since the Jul-2021 IPO, where Info Edge sold 4.93 cr shares for Rs375 cr). Info Edge was Zomato's largest shareholder at 12.38% in Jun-2026.
